SOURCE.MD CONTAINS TWO DOCUMENTS: the markitdown conversion of that article, followed by an explicitly delimited appendix, the official BCI Competition IV data set 2a description desc_2a.pdf by Brunner, Leeb, Mueller-Putz, Schloegl and Pfurtscheller, retrieved 2026-07-31 from https://www.bbci.de/competition/iv/desc_2a.pdf. The appendix was added because the Frontiers review does not carry the per-dataset recording parameters this strand's card schema requires; the delimiter banner in source.md names its provenance. That second document carries no licence statement and is NOT archived as a PDF; its markdown extraction is retained as internal research notes under fair use. DATA LICENCE: none formally stated. The review says the data 'can be freely assessed via http://www.bbci.de/competition/iv/ with the only restriction that the present article is referenced upon any publication of results.' md_quality is rough, and unevenly so: the Frontiers portion is a heavily interleaved two-column extraction in which Table 3 (the data set 2a competition results) is unusable as a table and its kappa values are recoverable only because the body prose repeats them, the causality equations lost their subscripts onto separate lines, all figures are lost including the electrode-layout figure, and the reference list is a three-column interleave that must not be cited from. The appended Brunner description is single-column and came through cleanly, with two exceptions noted on the card: the subject identifier A04T was displaced three lines from its sentence, and the causality subscripts fail the same way. Tables 1 and 2 of the appendix (file list and event codes) survived as real markdown tables.
